changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: Native Hibernate JSON cutover requires all five source columns to be jsonb and auth_event to retain its native partition layout.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND NOT a.attisdropped AND a.atttypid = 'jsonb'::regtype AND (c.relname, a.attname) IN (('auth_event','details'), ('config_audit_event','old_value'), ('config_audit_event','new_value'), ('project_field','options'), ('connection_audit','detail'))
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_partitioned_table WHERE partrelid = 'public.auth_event'::regclass AND partstrat = 'r' AND pg_get_partkeydef(partrelid) = 'RANGE (occurred_at)' AND partdefid <> 0

changeSet.comment: Convert semantic Strings once without row updates or audit guard changes. Resolve the pg_partman template before any table rewrite.

rollback.stop: Stop all runtime roles and restore the verified database backup from before the native Hibernate JSON cutover. TEXT cannot recover the original JSONB representation.
